'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Hangu mosque bombing]]
***Five people are killed and ten others are injured by two suicide bombers at a [[mosque]] in [[Hangu, Pakistan|Hangu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], Pakistan. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/29/several-killed-as-another-blast-hits-pakistan-on-prophets-birthday (Al Jazeera)]
**Four [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] and three [[Pakistani Taliban]] militants are killed during a [[shootout]] in [[Zhob]], Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. [https://www.aajenglish.tv/news/30335287/four-soldiers-martyred-in-fire-exchange-with-terrorists-in-zhob (Aaj English Tv)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2023 Mastung bombing]]
***At least 50 people are killed and more than 50 others are injured in a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] at a [[religious gathering]] in [[Mastung, Pakistan|Mastung]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66956626 (BBC News)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2023 Mogadishu tea shop bombing|Mogadishu tea shop bombing]]
***At least five people are killed and 18 others are injured when an [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] suicide bomber [[detonate]]s his [[explosive belt]] in a tea shop in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suicide-bomber-kills-7-somali-tea-shop-2023-09-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Toys "R" Us]] announces plans to open 24 new flagship stores across the [[United States]], along with new shops in airports and on [[cruise ship]]s, after the company filed for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]] six years ago. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/09/29/business/toys-r-us-new-stores.html (''The New York Times'')] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[September 2023 New York floods]]
**[[New York City]] declares a [[state of emergency]] due to widespread flooding caused by heavy rain. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/29/weather/new-york-city-northeast-rain-flood-forecast-climate-friday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh fuel depot explosion]]
**The death toll from an [[explosion]] at a fuel warehouse in [[Berkadzor]], [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]], on Monday increases to 170 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/death-toll-fuel-depot-blast-karabakh-rises-170-media-2023-09-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[M53 motorway coach crash]]
**Two people are killed and 17 injured after a [[school bus]] crashes into a [[central reservation]] and overturns in [[The Wirral]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-66977287 (BBC News)]
*Nine people are killed, four others are trapped, and 21 are rescued after a [[mine collapse]]s in [[Chegutu]], [[Mashonaland West]], [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.newzimbabwe.com/9-dead-4-missing-and-21-survivors-in-chegutu-mine-disaster/ (New Zimbabwe)]
*Five people are killed and five more are hospitalized as a [[semi truck]] carrying a toxic substance turns over near [[Teutopolis, Illinois|Teutopolis]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]], causing [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/sep/30/illinois-truck-crash-toxic-ammonia (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Murder of Tupac Shakur]]
**[[Duane Davis (gangster)|Duane "Keefe D" Davis]] is arrested by police for the 1996 [[murder in United States law|murder]] of American [[rap]]per [[Tupac Shakur]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/29/us/tupac-shakur-murder-suspect-arrested/index.html (CNN)]
*A second suspect, a man in his sixties, is arrested in connection with the [[felling]] of the [[Sycamore Gap Tree]] in [[Northumberland]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/sycamore-gap-tree-second-person-arrested-in-connection-with-felling-of-iconic-landmark-12972772 (Sky News)]
